# three.js add-ons (r186)

Copied unchanged from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.186.0/examples/jsm/<path>`
on 2026-10-08, to match the vendored core
`../three.module.min.js` (0.186.0). MIT licence: `LICENSE` beside this file.

Use with an import map:

    { "imports": { "three": "/shared/vendor/three/three.module.min.js",
                   "three/addons/": "/shared/vendor/three/addons/" } }

Files: loaders/GLTFLoader.js, loaders/HDRLoader.js, loaders/RGBELoader.js,
utils/BufferGeometryUtils.js, utils/SkeletonUtils.js, controls/OrbitControls.js,
environments/RoomEnvironment.js, geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js,
postprocessing/{EffectComposer,RenderPass,ShaderPass,MaskPass,Pass,UnrealBloomPass,OutputPass}.js,
shaders/{CopyShader,LuminosityHighPassShader,OutputShader}.js.
Add another by fetching the same path at the same version.
